intentions: Allow staff to add, view, and manage hotel rooms with unique identifiers and availability status
Enable staff to register and manage guest information including names, contact details, and booking preferences
Provide a booking interface where staff can assign rooms to guests for specific dates and durations
Implement a conflict detection system to prevent double booking of the same room during overlapping periods
Ensure room availability is updated in real-time to reflect current bookings and prevent accidental overbooking
